title: State Migration Rollback and Atomic Commit Safety
objective: Execute a schema migration adding a column with foreign key constraints while preserving existing records

input_context.migration_step: ALTER TABLE / recreate with foreign key verification
constraints: Zero data loss on existing records

rubric.requirement_satisfaction: Schema updated with verified integrity and zero broken references
rubric.source_fidelity: Pre-existing rows match bit-for-bit after migration
rubric.continuity: Database connection remains valid without locks
rubric.useful_novelty: Atomic transitional staging preventing torn state
